prompt:
AUTHOR A NEW TRANSPARENT RGBA PIXEL-ART ANIMATION SHEET. Exactly16 independent full-body Thiếu Lâm monk poses in a4x4 equal-cell grid, generous transparent gutters. ALL SIXTEEN sprites must FACE SCREEN LEFT at every instant: nose points LEFT, face/eyes on LEFT side of skull, left-going attack extension toward LEFT edge. This is NOT a four-direction sheet. No right-facing sprites at all. The referenced approved monk identity is locked: bald stern male, compact sturdy2.5-head proportions, ochre saffron short robe, brown sash and trousers, dark wooden beads, white wraps and dark shoes, upper-left lighting, elevated three-quarter orthographic overworld view. Both hands empty, no weapons/VFX/shadows/labels/grid paint. Fresh original deliberate poses, not image transforms. Same body size in all16cells. Each ROW is a different skill; each row's four columns are stance, strong preparation, full contact, grounded recovery, ALL FACING LEFT. Respect the specific ROW choreography:
ROW1 La Hán Quyền: Heavy closed-fist punch: low planted guard, chamber right fist, powerful short frontal punch, recover into protective guard. No open-palm spell.
ROW2 Vi Đà Quyền: Deliberate armor-breaking fist strike: crossed guard, turn hip and chamber fist, short driving hammer-like punch, retract. Distinct from La Han's straight guard punch.
ROW3 Đại Lực Kim Cương Chưởng: Heavy open-palm finisher: sink weight, draw open right palm to waist, thrust a large readable palm forward with planted legs, recover. Same monk, no giant replacement body.
ROW4 Toàn Phong Thoái: Spinning kick: guard/coil torso, turn on planted supporting foot and lift knee, extend sweeping spinning kick through facing direction, settle to guard. Clear wrapped feet and physically coherent hips.
Preserve feet and complete silhouettes, natural anatomy. Left-hand side of page is the attack direction. Crisp pixel cluster artwork matching approved reference. Character only, no trails or glows. No blank cells or repeated static poses. The purpose is to correct earlier incorrectly right-facing left rows, not redesign character.
